explanation: Faithfully states Adenwalla's observation (from Croot's theorem) on erdosproblems.com/319: the largest A ⊆ [1,N] admitting signs with Σ δ_n/n = 0 and no nonempty proper subset summing to 0 has size ≥ (1 - 1/e + o(1))N. The sSup is over a finite nonempty set (∅ qualifies vacuously), so it is a genuine maximum.
